question: Hello Oda-sensei! I'm a boy who will be entering my first year of middle school this year. I have a question for you. I'm currently obsessed with ONE PIECE. I like Kizaru. My father has the first 82 volumes of the manga and I'm reading through them. I'd like to get him to buy volumes 83 and onwards. Do you have any good strategies? Please teach me. no Yota
answer: I want to buy them for you!! I want to buy one for all the boys who read the manga without flinching at the fact that it's over 100 volumes!! But that's not realistic, so go with the "shoulder massage strategy"!! There is no parent who wouldn't love to have their shoulders massaged by their child!! Volume 82 is where Momonosuke vows to avenge his father. With his shoulders and heart relaxed, you should say Father, I want to defeat Kaidou!!! That will do it!!!
name: Yakiniku no Yota
